name: Matt Girgenti
headline: VP of Professional Services at New Era Technology
about:
As a national VP, my primary responsibilities include oversight of all Deployment Coordination Services, Systems Integration and PMO staffing and delivery, coordination with Partner Alliance Manager for strategic partners relations, while setting the reference architectures and standards for consumption by other departments in the organization. 

I work closely with the sales staff for pipeline planning, staffing, and ensure client satisfaction throughout the project Lifecyle, and coordinate with the business and operations office for proper budgeting, P&L tracking, and future state goals and execution.

As a tech at heart moving up over the years, I always balance client needs with the life-work balance of the staff, coordinating to ensure the success of both. I enjoy the opportunities at FlexManage because we are experienced and respected in the industry ensuring strong strategic relationship while remaining nimble to adapt to the speed of today’s technology. As we often blaze the trail with bleeding edge technology, we work diligently to ensure client delivery as well as updating vendor development teams of our findings, road bumps, or areas for improvement. A primary function of Systems Integration team is to develop, prove, and produce the reference architecture for the entire firm, including hardware and software to provide supportable, long-last client solutions. This means staying current on new offering and evaluating beyond the marketing material into actual results that directly address our clients asks. 

The main objective of my role is to maximize the efficient use of the Systems Integration and Project Management teams to create a fast-paced, fun, and energetic workplace where every member has every opportunity to succeed and shine, measured directly by creating raving fans kept as trusted customers many years.

experiences.description:
"Flexible technology solutions that enable business transformation through Consulting, Cloud, and Managed Services."

FlexManage is a business and IT consulting firm that empowers enterprise, middle market and small organizations with services across four core solution areas: 
1.) Strategy & Execution
2.) Business Operations
3.) Applications
4.) Infrastructure

We focus on delivering all of our business and technology consulting services with thought-leadership, seasoned senior consultants and strong business acumen.  Our employees work diligently to develop customer relationships built upon mutual respect and innovation, while emphasizing business and technical excellence in everything we do so each project delivers maximized value and return to the client. 

With a strong presence in the legal, healthcare, and O&G markets, FlexManage is national organization headquartered in Chicago with offices in Boston, Houston, New Orleans, Sacramento, San Francisco and Seattle.
